descriptionHtml:
Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S17 Web: microphone blocked, and no microphone at all — every Dictate button explains how to enable it, typed text stays

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U8 Microphone permission denied, or the mic didn't start: an explicit message explaining how to enable it; a denied permission is handled without a crash. (UAT EFS state 8; TFA-94745 state 8; TFA-92570 AC 4)
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection). (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 5)
  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content. (UAT EFS intro; UAT 3.4; TFA-94745 AC 2)
  • U13 Nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost in any failure state. (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 3)
  • U14 Every state works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android. (UAT EFS Expected Result; UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Run 1: browser with microphone permission denied. Run 2: browser with no capture device. Standard fixture

When Type a line, then tap Dictate once in: the Hospital pre-round editor, the Hospital Encounter box, the Ask AI sheet, the Nursing Home visit box

Then Each tap shows a message that names the microphone and how to allow / enable it; no crash, no raw browser error; the typed line is still there. Run 2 is the 'mic didn't start' class (Q6)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From U8: mustContain 'microphone' and the typed line; mustContainAny ['allow', 'enable', 'settings']; mustNotContain 'NotAllowedError', 'DOMException', 'undefined'

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S17 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
